The API also coordinates the payment flow shown in the booking slide. No Whisper route is registered in the current server.

text:
The Eighth Schedule lists 22 languages. English is not in that list, so retaining English while covering every scheduled language implies 23 language options in total. Names use common contemporary spellings. A scheduled language can use more than one script, and regional accents require separate testing. Do not equate a translated menu with validated end-to-end voice support.

text:
WER means word error rate. Critical entities include names, dates and amounts, which can matter even when overall WER appears low. Report results by language, accent and test condition rather than hiding weak languages in an average. Include noisy audio, mixed-language speech and provider outages. Use legal reviewers for expected classifications. Measure both latency and cost per completed case before commercial claims.
